### Filter

```{ojs}
viewof clearFilters = Inputs.button("Clear filters")
```

```{ojs}
viewof filters = {
  clearFilters;   // re-run (and so reset) this form whenever "Clear filters" is clicked
  const types = P.unique(data, "datatype");
  const extra = types.length > 1
    ? {datatype: Inputs.checkbox(types, {label: "Data type", format: dtName})}
    : {};
  return P.filterForm(data, filterCols, extra);
}

  const byType = P.assignRows(codePanels, codeRows);
  if (!codeRows.length) return md`*No datapoints match the filters.*`;
  const parts = [...byType].map(([id, rs]) => `${rs.length} ${dtName(id)}`).join(", ");
  return html`<small>Code for ${selection.length ? "ticked rows" : "all filtered rows"}: ${parts}.</small>`;
}

//| output: false
import {makePortal} from "../assets/portal.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// ---- Libraries -------------------------------------------------------------------
leaflet = require("leaflet@1.9.4")

Mustache = {
  const mod = await require("mustache@4.2.0");
  const m = mod.default ?? mod;
  m.escape = s => String(s);   // we are generating code, not HTML: never escape
  return m;
}

P = makePortal({d3, Inputs, html, DOM, leaflet, Mustache})

// ---- Data written by build.R -----------------------------------------------------
meta = FileAttachment("../_generated/projects/{{id}}.json").json()
raw  = FileAttachment("../_generated/projects/{{id}}.csv").csv()

// The data types in this project vary, so their files are fetched by URL
// (_quarto.yml copies _generated/** to the site).
projectDatatypes = P.asArray(meta.datatypes)

dtMeta = {
  const pairs = await Promise.all(projectDatatypes.map(async id =>
    [id, await d3.json(`../_generated/datatypes/${id}.json`)]));
  return new Map(pairs);
}

dtRowsByUid = {
  const tables = await Promise.all(projectDatatypes.map(id =>
    d3.csv(`../_generated/datatypes/${id}.csv`)));
  return new Map(tables.flat().map(r => [r.uid, r]));
}

dtName = id => dtMeta.get(id)?.name ?? id

// ---- Columns (the project's own) ----------------------------------------------------
colInfo    = P.normalizeColumns(meta.columns)
cols       = colInfo.cols
publicCols = colInfo.publicCols
filterCols = colInfo.filterCols

sharedLabels = ({datatype: "Data type", datapoint_name: "Name", plot: "Plot", site: "Site",
                 date: "Date", lat: "Latitude", lon: "Longitude"})
labelOf = col => sharedLabels[col] ?? cols.find(c => c.column === col)?.label ?? col

tableCols = ["datatype", "datapoint_name", "plot", "site", "date", ...publicCols.map(c => c.column)]

// ---- Rows ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Each row = the data type's full row (so templates can use its columns, including
// hidden ones) with the project's row on top (shared and project-specific columns).
data = P.prepareRows(raw, cols, {
  merge: r => dtRowsByUid.get(r.uid) ?? {},
  text:  r => [dtName(r.datatype)]
})

filtered = data.filter(d =>
  P.matches(d, filters, filterCols) &&
  (!filters.datatype?.length || filters.datatype.includes(d.datatype)))

codeRows = selection.length ? selection : filtered
```
